name: FortuneWheel swapProfitFees spot-price LINK top-up sandwich
summary: FortuneWheel's public swapProfitFees() sized each casino's LINK top-up with getAmountsIn at the spot LINK/WBNB price, took the shortfall from casino liquidity and swapped with zero minimum output. The attacker pumped LINK in the PancakeSwap LINK/WBNB pair with flash-loaned WBNB, called swapProfitFees so the contract spent the BNB and BNBP casinos' entire liquidity buying LINK, and sold the LINK back.
notes: The reset is addCasino listing the BNB and BNBP casinos whose liquidity was drained, 7 blocks after deployment; later writes are bets, round results and a max-bet change.

Campaign: a copycat a day later ran the same swapProfitFees sandwich against JPulsepot's RoulettePotV2 0xf5737486, which carries the same function. Earlier swapProfitFees calls on both contracts were by the deployer or bought LINK and BNBP at unmanipulated prices.

BNBP had no price; the contracts sold it into the unmanipulated BNBP/WBNB pair before spending the proceeds on LINK, so it is valued at those proceeds (16.831183 BNB in the anchor, 37.794796 BNB in the copycat; rule 12).
